newsitem.title: USA: IMC-Agrico resumes capacity diammonium operations.
newsitem.headline: IMC-Agrico resumes capacity diammonium operations.

text.p: IMC-Agrico Co said Wednesday its New Wales plant in central Florida resumed capacity operating rates for diammonium phosphate.
The plant had been operating at 80 percent of capacity -- 50,000 tons per month below its capacity -- since February 20.
IMC-Agrico is a joint venture between IMC Global Inc and Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP. Freeport-McMoRan is 51 percent owned by Freeport-McMoRan Inc.

"The decision to return to capacity output at New Wales is a result of the now strengthening demand associated with the domestic spring season and increased activity and outlook in the international arena," said Richard Block, president of the joint venture.
Block added that previously idled facilities in Florida and Louisiana are in a standby mode and can be returned to service in a matter of days.
